known_uncertainty.summary: Review by a qualified FOIA, cybersecurity-records, sealing, and appellate practitioner remains pending; no independent review is recorded and no level-3 or gold claim is made.

Automated schema, citation, digest, render, and record-capability checks do not establish the legal accuracy, completeness, currency, or practical realism of the authored FOIA, Exemption 7(E), Exemption 7(F), Vaughn, segregability, or sealing analysis.

Record tags, stable-anchor mappings, and future workflow bindings are authored for exact identified documents and do not generalize to novel filings, altered bytes, or unreviewed procedural circumstances.

The actual record supports Exemption 7(E) protection for fictional operational decision-tree implementation relationships but does not supply the item-specific Exemption 7(F), Vaughn, and segregability proof assumed by the isolated counterfactual. The system does not infer those legal showings from arbitrary cyber-response text.

The record models seventeen public/sealed disclosure pairs through bijective page mappings, public-default projection, exact-document session grants, revocation, and deferred per-open CAS verification. Those controls establish repository behavior for the frozen bytes, not the legal propriety of sealing or authorization in another matter.

PA156–PA364 are never-filed counterfactual branch artifacts on a distinct synthetic docket. Actual-history operations, the actual disposition, and actual-record argument questions must exclude those pages even though the complete training record resolves their anchors.

The authored documents support five source-faithful workflow paths: actual ordinary mandate; counterfactual rehearing denial; counterfactual mandate-stay denial after rehearing denial; rehearing-grant mandate-stayed; and rehearing-grant supplemental merits through revised mandate. Workflow authoring and replay remain pending, and no unsupported sixth path may be manufactured.

The planned counterfactual rehearing-grant route must represent vacatur and revised judgment without treating the never-filed documents as actual history. Production validation must disclose any engine boundary rather than inventing a source fact or silently combining mutually exclusive mandate routes.

All parties, people, offices, systems, addresses, dockets, identifiers, facts, and events are fictional. Cyber-response descriptions are intentionally abstract and non-actionable; repository checks cannot establish external authenticity or authorize use as operational guidance.

The Vale, Quill, and Reed profiles and oral-argument behavior are fictional or composite training constructs; differentiation does not model a real judge or predict actual advocacy, questioning, or outcomes.

The PDFs are generated training artifacts. Source-to-PDF checks, the accepted render inventory, and pinned hashes document repository provenance but cannot establish external authenticity, future cross-render byte determinism, or complete accessibility and typography quality.
